tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: In the AY 2018-19, The appeal to the Commissioner of Income Tax - Appeal, National Faceless Appeal Center is preferred by the company against the order passed by the National Faceless assessment Center under section 147 of the Income Tax act on 18.03.2024 in which the Income tax department has held that company has availed accommodation entry by giving donation to AISECT amounting to Rs.11,00,000/- which is added in the income of the appellant u/s 69C r.w.s 115BBE of the act.
